mainEntity.name: Can AI automate the creation of a digital product, or will the result feel generic and low quality?

acceptedAnswer.text: AI can support digital product creation by organizing research, outlining lessons, drafting scripts, preparing slides, and repurposing material, but the owner must verify accuracy and usefulness. Context: Run My AI Biz’s examples cover course planning, presentations, lesson scripts, video production, video editing, supporting materials, sales copy, and launch preparation. Key factors: audience knowledge, instructional sequence, originality, factual accuracy, accessibility, and product promises. Practical guidance: define learning outcomes first, provide source material, review every lesson, and test the product with a small audience before a broader release. Keep AI-generated claims and examples aligned with what the product actually delivers. Run My AI Biz can help connect product development with the marketing and launch tasks that follow.
acceptedAnswer.description: AI can speed research, outlines, scripts, slides, and supporting materials, but quality depends on clear learning goals, original expertise, accurate sources, and human editing. Review every asset, test it with a small audience, and ensure the sales promise matches the finished product.
